description: Execute a PIPEDA/Quebec Law 25 right-to-erasure request for a phone number. Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED. Erases message bodies (keeping message metadata), consent records, verifications, contacts, non-DENY contact-list entries, and webhook dead letters referencing the number. Opt-out records are NOT erased (CASL requires keeping them as compliance evidence), and any DENY-list block on the number is kept so the number stays blocked; the response reports opt_outs_preserved: true. Creates an immutable audit log entry.

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number to erase data for.

reason.description: Reason for the erasure request (recorded in the audit log).

name: request_erasure
title: Erase subscriber data
